messages:
olga: Hey team — PR #31211 is ready but blocked by a persistent flake on integration-acceptance/linux-arm. We need a quick rebase+rerun and a short merge window before next maintenance. Can someone help rerun and give eyes?

ci-bot: integration-acceptance/linux-arm: failed on step 'image-push' (transient network / registry timeout). Suggest rerun: `/ci rerun job=linux-arm`

mike: can you paste the CI link?

olga: https://ci.redwood/31211/build/847 — logs show `docker: error writing blob` only on arm runners, looks transient but repeats across 3 attempts.

ashley: i can watch the rerun and approve if it passes. ping me when started.

kai: heads-up: there's a DB maintenance window Tue 05:00-06:00 UTC. prefer not to merge during that. propose rebase + canary on Mon 22:00-23:30 UTC instead.

release-coordinator: Can we land as canary=1 if green? Also, is this change behind a feature flag so we can roll back safely?

olga: yes — it's behind `edge-opt-2026` flag. small routing tweak. canary safe.

mike: i can do the rebase and trigger CI now. should be quick; master had a lockfile bump but nothing huge.

mike: `/ci rerun integration-acceptance --job=linux-arm`

ci-bot: Triggered rerun: build 848 for PR 31211. Watch: https://ci.redwood/31211/build/848

ci-bot: build 848: linux-arm ✅ all tests passed

ashley: ran a quick local smoke on arm emulation, looks good. approving now :thumbsup:

release-coordinator: Nice — we'll schedule a canary rollout Mon 22:30 UTC, monitor for 30m. If metrics stable, proceed full rollout at 23:05 UTC. Fallback plan: immediate rollback and disable `edge-opt-2026`.

olga: thanks! I'll merge once mike pushes the rebased branch and after the approval + green CI. i'll add rollout notes to the PR description.

mike: :eyes: merging in ~2m, tagging the canary schedule in the PR body.

ci-bot: merge succeeded, PR 31211 merged into main (commit 9f2a4b).

release-coordinator: Canary scheduled. I'll post a short postmortem if anything odd shows up.

olga: appreciate everyone stepping in.
